decisions.reason: {{harvp}} is a Harvard short-citation link, not a footnote template and not a generator of its own footnote on enwiki (3.1 names only sfn and harvnb-style templates that generate a footnote). It sits inside the body of the unnamed <ref> at cp 4247, which the locked label lists as the single definition. The rendered footnote (cite_note-16) shows it as body text of that ref. No separate item.
